_comment: Per-file byte budgets for every SKILL.md and commands/*.md (CRLF counted as LF). Seeded at the size on origin/main when WF-268 PR 0 landed: a file may only shrink. Ratchet down by editing the number in the PR that shrinks the file. A new skill needs a row; the default target is default_target_bytes and any budget above it needs an entry in exemptions with a reason.

_comments.plugins/test-crucible/skills/test-suite-: Q3 (ratified): the WF-268 test-crucible PR targets 12288 bytes (12 KB), not the 10 KB default. It is the only skill with measured evidence (28 subagent runs, iteration-3 pass rates) and its phase one-liners are what the measurement says matters. Lower this budget to 12288 in that PR.
